description_en: Queries the settings of specified or all alert rules
description_zh: 查询指定或全部报警规则设置
kebab_example: aliyun cms list-alarm --id i-2ze3w55tr2rcpejpcfap_72071739-396b-497d-849c-59a73de44bcf --name '报警测试' --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --dimension instanceId_:_XXX --state ok --is-enable true --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --api-version 2018-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAlarm

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert rule. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The product name. Specify the project that corresponds to the product, such as acs_ecs_dashboard or acs_rds_dashboard
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称，参考各产品对应的project，例如 acs_ecs_dashboard, acs_rds_dashboard等
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The instance information associated with the rule. The value is a JSON object string, such as {"instanceId":"name1"}. You can use this parameter to query all rules associated with the specified instance. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify Namespace
parameters.help_zh: 规则关联的实例信息，为json object对应的字符串，例如{"instanceId":"name1"}。可以查询用于查询关联该实例的所有规则，应用该字段时必须指定Namespace
parameters.name: dimension

parameters.help_en: The status of the alert rule. Valid values: ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, and OK
parameters.help_zh: 报警规则状态， ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA，OK
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the alert rule is enabled. Valid values: true and false
parameters.name: is_enable

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

Alarm.description_en: The list of alert rule details

ContactGroups.description_en: The alert contact groups. The value is a JSON array string, such as `["ContactGroup1","ContactGroup2"]`
ContactGroups.description_zh: 通知的联系组，为json array对应的string，如`[“联系组1”,”联系组2”]`

Dimensions.description_en: The list of instances associated with the alert rule. The value is a JSON array string, such as `[{"instanceId":"name1"},{"instanceId":"name2"}]`
Dimensions.description_zh: 报警规则关联的实例列表，为json array对应的字符串，例如`[{"instanceId":"name1"},{"instanceId":"name2"}]`

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the rule is enabled. A value of true indicates that the rule is enabled
Enable.description_zh: 该规则是否启用，true为启动

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the effective period

EvaluationCount.description_en: The number of consecutive detection attempts that must meet the threshold condition before an alert is triggered. Default value: 3
EvaluationCount.description_zh: 连续探测几次都满足阈值条件时报警，默认3次

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

MetricName.description_en: The metric associated with the alert rule
MetricName.description_zh: 报警规则对应的监控项

Name.description_en: The name of the alert rule

Namespace.description_en: The product associated with the alert rule

NotifyType.description_en: The notification method. A value of 0 indicates TradeManager and email. A value of 1 indicates TradeManager, email, and text message
NotifyType.description_zh: 通知类型，值为0是旺旺+邮件，值为1是旺旺+邮件+短信

Period.description_en: The statistical period for querying the metric. Unit: seconds
Period.description_zh: 查询指标的周期，单位为秒

SilenceTime.description_en: The mute period during which the alert rule remains in the triggered state. Unit: seconds
SilenceTime.description_zh: 一直处于报警的沉默周期，单位为秒

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the effective period

State.description_en: The status of the alert rule. If any instance triggers an alert, the value is ALARM. If all instances have no data, the value is INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Otherwise, the value is OK
State.description_zh: 报警规则的状态，有一个实例报警就是ALARM，所有都没数据是INSUFFICIENT_DATA，其它情况为OK

Statistics.description_en: The statistical method, such as Average, Maximum, or Minimum

Webhook.description_en: The callback function. Only public URLs are supported. For more information about callback parameters, see [Use alert callbacks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60714.html）
Webhook.description_zh: 回调函数，只支持公网地址，回调参数请参考[使用报警回调]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/60714.html）

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure
Code.description_zh: 请求失败状态码，200为成功，非200为失败

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages exist
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页，为空代表没有下一页

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to query logs

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

Total.description_en: The total number of entries that match the specified conditions
